name: Coiled Stargorger Lure
tooltip:
Coiled Stargorger Lure
Item Level 1
Use: Throw the lure into any Atal'Utek fishing pool to turn it into a Torrential Gorgerswarm. This destroys the pool in the process.

The decomposition of the starfish attracts Coiled Stargorgers to the pool.
Requires Level 90
Max Stack: 1000
Sell Price: 75
